2. This first application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C/483 of BNSS has been filed for grant of bail.

3. The applicant has been arrested on 04.08.2024 in connection with Crime No.566/2024 registered at Police Station Karera, District Shivpuri for offence under Sections 303(2), 317(4) and 317(5) of BNS, 2023.
4.
It is submitted by counsel for the applicant that according to the prosecution case, 7 stolen motorcycles have been seized from the possession of the applicant.
In view of the criminal history of the applicant, he is ready and willing to abide by any stringent condition which may be imposed by this Court.

Except one more case which was registered for the offence punishable under Sections 457 and 383 of IPC, no other offence of NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-GWL:19681 2 MCRC-45231-2024 theft of motorcycle has been registered against the applicant.
The applicant is in jail since 04.08.2024.
The trial is likely to take sufficiently long time and there is no possibility of his absconding or tampering with the prosecution case.

sentences.text: Per contra, the application is vehemently opposed by the counsel for the State.

It is submitted that as per the criminal history of the applicant received from the Police Station Karera, five more offences i.e. 420/2016, 233/2017, 479/2018, 98/2022 and 714/2022 are also registered against the applicant.
However, he fairly conceded that in offence which was registered under Section 34(2) of Excise Act, the applicant has already been acquitted.

6. Looking to the number of motorcycles seized from the possession of the applicant as well as the criminal history and period of detention, this Court is of the considered opinion that the applicant can be granted bail on some stringent condition.

7. Accordingly, it is directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rs. One Lac only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Trial Court.
The bail order shall remain in force till the final disposal of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump, the trial court shall be free to cancel the bail.
8. The applicant is also directed to mark his presence before SHO, Police Station Karera, District Shivpuri on 1st and 15th of every month.
This condition shall remain in force till the conclusion of the trial.

9. In the light of judgment passed by the Supreme Court in the case NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2024:MPHC-GWL:19681 3 MCRC-45231-2024 o f XYZ and others Vs. State of M.P. and another,
reported in (2021) 16 SCC 179 an information regarding grant of bail be sent to the complainant.
